title: `uv add --index <name>=<url> <package>` can overwrite an index of the wrong format
author: EliteTK

author: EliteTK

title: `uv add --index <name>=<url> <package>` can resolve differently to a subsequent `uv lock`
author: EliteTK
body_preview: If `<name>` is an implicit index in a `pyproject.toml`, `uv add --index <name>=<url> <package>` will update the index URL, pin the package, re-order the index to be at the top/first, and keep it implicit.
